content: {"summary":"Customers report that Xbox Live Gold purchases often activate only for free‑play content, while multiplayer and party features remain inaccessible, causing frustration and repeated prompts to buy Gold again. The issue appears across multiple purchase channels—Amazon, prepaid cards, and direct console transactions—yet the console still displays the membership as active. Users have attempted restarts, profile deletions, and console resets without resolution, indicating a systemic activation sync problem. This widespread activation glitch is negatively impacting the multiplayer experience for a large portion of the user base."}
